summary: ReBarUEFI is a command‑line utility that patches UEFI firmware to enable Resizable BAR support, improving GPU memory allocation. It is built in C and distributed as a source repository that compiles to a CLI binary. The tool is aimed at advanced users who need to modify firmware on a wide range of systems, especially gamers and PC builders. It stands out with relatively fast patching times (0.699 s install) but suffers from limited documentation and a low test pass rate (1/3).
